contentHtml:
In 2026, office interior design in Gurgaon costs ₹1,200 to ₹7,000+ per sq ft. Most turnkey corporate fit-outs land between ₹1,800 and ₹4,500 per sq ft, covering design, civil work, MEP, furniture and handover. A 2,500 sq ft office typically costs ₹45 lakh to ₹1.1 crore and takes 8 to 12 weeks to complete after design sign-off.

If you have just signed a lease in Cyber City, Golf Course Road or Sohna Road, the next question is always the same: what will the fit-out cost? Most answers online give a single rate with no context. That is not much use when you have to present a number to your CFO or board.

This guide breaks the cost down the way we quote it at The Omega Group: per sq ft by finish level, per seat, by office size, by cost head, and by timeline. It also lists the hidden costs that tend to come up mid-project.

Office interior design cost in Gurgaon per sq ft (2026)

Office interiors in Gurgaon cost ₹1,200–₹1,800 per sq ft at a basic level, ₹1,800–₹2,800 for mid-range corporate, ₹2,800–₹4,500 for premium and ₹4,500–₹7,000+ for luxury or CXO floors. The rates below are for turnkey execution on carpet area. They include design, civil and partition work, false ceiling, electrical, lighting, flooring, workstations and basic HVAC distribution. Rates assume a warm-shell space with building AC and basic ceiling grid in place.

Finish levelCost per sq ftBest suited forWhat you get
Basic / Functional₹1,200 – ₹1,800Startups, back offices, small teamsModular workstations, gypsum partitions, grid ceiling, vinyl or tile flooring, standard LED lighting
Mid-Range Corporate₹1,800 – ₹2,800Growing SMEs, regional officesGlass cabins, acoustic meeting rooms, carpet tiles, branded reception, designed lighting, pantry
Premium₹2,800 – ₹4,500MNC branches, consulting and finance firmsCustom joinery, veneer and stone finishes, VAV-zoned HVAC, AV-ready boardrooms, wellness areas
Luxury / CXO₹4,500 – ₹7,000+Headquarters, family offices, CXO floorsImported finishes, bespoke furniture, smart lighting and automation, art-led design, private suites

Bare shell vs warm shell: If your space is a bare shell (no AC, no ceiling, raw floor), add roughly ₹600 to ₹1,200 per sq ft for HVAC installation, fire sprinkler extensions and floor screeding. Always confirm the handover condition with your landlord before you compare quotes.

Per Sq Ft vs Per Seat: Which Number Should You Budget With?

Per-sq-ft pricing tells you how expensive the fit-out is. Per-seat pricing tells you how expensive it is for your business. A 3,000 sq ft office at ₹2,800 per sq ft costs ₹84 lakh either way, but if one company seats 25 people in it and another seats 35, the cost per employee is very different.

The simple formula is: Cost per seat = Cost per sq ft × Sq ft allotted per seat. The sq ft per seat is the full office area divided by headcount, so it includes your share of reception, meeting rooms, pantry and circulation, not just the desk.

Office planning styleSq ft per seatAt ₹2,000 / sq ftAt ₹3,000 / sq ftAt ₹4,500 / sq ft
Dense (ops, support, sales floors)50 – 70₹1.0 – 1.4 L₹1.5 – 2.1 L₹2.3 – 3.2 L
Standard corporate80 – 110₹1.6 – 2.2 L₹2.4 – 3.3 L₹3.6 – 5.0 L
Cabin-heavy / leadership floors120 – 150₹2.4 – 3.0 L₹3.6 – 4.5 L₹5.4 – 6.8 L

When to use which: use per-sq-ft to compare designers and tiers; use per-seat to compare locations, lease options and whether a larger or smaller floor plate makes financial sense for your headcount plan.

How much does a turnkey office fit-out cost by office size?

A full turnkey fit-out costs about ₹18–28 lakh for a 1,000 sq ft office at mid-range finishes, rising to ₹1.8–2.8 crore for 10,000 sq ft. Here is what it typically costs by carpet area, at mid-range and premium finish levels:

Office size (carpet)Approx. seatsMid-range budgetPremium budgetExecution timeline
1,000 sq ft12 – 18₹18 – 28 lakh₹28 – 45 lakh5 – 7 weeks
2,500 sq ft25 – 35₹45 – 70 lakh₹70 lakh – 1.1 crore8 – 10 weeks
5,000 sq ft50 – 70₹90 lakh – 1.4 crore₹1.4 – 2.25 crore10 – 12 weeks
10,000 sq ft100 – 140₹1.8 – 2.8 crore₹2.8 – 4.5 crore12 – 16 weeks
20,000+ sq ft200+₹3.6 crore+₹5.6 crore+16 – 24 weeks

Seat counts assume 70 to 100 sq ft per person, which is where most hybrid-era offices in Gurgaon now land. Budgets exclude GST, loose décor and IT hardware.

Where the money goes: cost breakdown by head

MEP (electrical, HVAC, fire and plumbing) is the biggest share of an office fit-out at 25–35%, and the line most often underestimated. On a typical mid-range to premium fit-out, the budget splits roughly as follows:

Cost headShare of budgetWhat it covers
MEP (electrical, HVAC, fire, plumbing)25 – 35%Wiring, DB panels, UPS points, AC ducting or VRV, sprinkler and smoke detector tie-ins, pantry and washroom plumbing
Furniture and workstations20 – 25%Workstations, cabin desks, ergonomic chairs, meeting tables, storage, reception desk
Civil work and partitions15 – 20%Glass and gypsum partitions, acoustic walls, cabins, doors, washroom civil
False ceiling and lighting8 – 12%Gypsum and grid ceilings, acoustic panels, LED and feature lighting
Flooring and finishes8 – 12%Carpet tiles, vinyl, wooden or stone flooring, paint, wall cladding
IT, AV and networking5 – 8%Structured cabling, server room, boardroom AV, access control, CCTV
Design and project management5 – 10%Space planning, 3D visualisation, drawings, site supervision, approvals

How long does an office fit-out take in Gurgaon?

A mid-sized Gurgaon office of 2,500 to 5,000 sq ft typically takes 12 to 16 weeks end to end. Here is how that time breaks down:

StageDurationKey output
1. Brief and site survey1 weekHeadcount plan, measured drawings, building rules checked
2. Space planning and concept1 – 2 weeksLayout options, mood boards, budget estimate
3. 3D design and material selection2 – 3 weeksApproved 3D views, material samples, final BOQ
4. Approvals and procurement1 – 2 weeksBuilding fit-out approval, fire layout, orders placed
5. Site execution6 – 12 weeksCivil, MEP, ceiling, flooring, joinery, furniture
6. Testing, snagging and handover1 weekHVAC and fire testing, defect list closed, handover

Tip: Negotiate a 60 to 90-day rent-free fit-out period with your landlord before signing. In Cyber City, where rents run ₹120 to ₹200+ per sq ft per month, every week of delay costs real money.

7 factors that change your office interior cost

Handover condition, building rules, the cabin ratio, acoustics, HVAC, furniture and technology move an office budget the most:

  • Handover condition: Bare shell needs HVAC and fire work that a warm-shell space already has.
  • Building location and rules: Grade-A towers on Golf Course Road and in Cyber City often restrict noisy work to nights and weekends, which raises labour costs. Older buildings in Udyog Vihar usually need more civil and electrical upgrades.
  • Open plan vs cabin ratio: Every closed cabin adds partition, ceiling, lighting and HVAC cost. A 70:30 open-to-closed ratio costs noticeably less than 50:50.
  • Acoustic requirements: Soundproof meeting rooms and phone booths need double-glazed partitions and acoustic insulation.
  • HVAC system: Tapping into the building chiller is cheaper than installing an independent VRV system, but less flexible after hours.
  • Furniture choice: Ready modular workstations cost far less than custom-built joinery. Ergonomic chairs alone can range from ₹8,000 to ₹60,000 per seat.
  • Technology layer: Video-conferencing rooms, access control, smart lighting and occupancy sensors add 5 to 10% to the budget.

For layout and design ideas to go with these numbers, see our office interior design ideas.

Hidden costs to budget for

GST, approvals, fire work, night-work premiums, backup power, signage and debris removal rarely appear on a first quote but almost always show up on the final invoice. Ask for each one in writing.

Hidden costTypical rangeHow to control it
GST on works contract18% on taxable valueConfirm whether quotes are inclusive or exclusive of GST
Building fit-out deposit and approvals₹50,000 – ₹5 lakhGet the landlord fit-out manual before design starts
Fire NOC and sprinkler modification₹80 – ₹200 per sq ftHave the fire layout approved before ceiling work begins
Night or weekend work premium10 – 20% on labourCheck building working hours at the site survey stage
DG and UPS backup₹3 – 15 lakhSize backup to critical loads only
Signage and branding₹1 – 8 lakhInclude in the design scope from day one
Debris removal and site protection₹30,000 – ₹2 lakhMake it a line item in the BOQ

For a broader look at how interior budgets drift during execution, see our guide to hidden interior design costs in Gurgaon.

Turnkey vs design-only: which costs less?

For offices above 2,000 sq ft, turnkey usually works out cheaper overall because rework, idle rent and change orders shrink. Design-only firms charge 7 to 15% of project value, or ₹150 to ₹500 per sq ft, and leave execution to separate contractors. This looks cheaper on paper. In practice, coordination gaps between the designer, civil contractor, MEP vendor and furniture supplier are the most common cause of delays and variation orders.

A turnkey partner takes one contract and one point of accountability from concept to handover.

FactorTurnkeyDesign-only + contractors
Contracts to manageOne4 – 6
Budget certaintyHigh (fixed BOQ)Low to medium
Timeline riskLowerHigher (vendor handoffs)
Accountability for defectsSingle partnerSplit across vendors
Best forMost offices above 2,000 sq ftSmall refreshes with in-house PM

How The Omega Group delivers office interiors in Gurgaon

The Omega Group delivers turnkey commercial interiors across Gurgaon and Delhi NCR, from compact startup offices to multi-floor corporate headquarters. Every project follows one process: concept, 3D visualisation, material selection, site supervision and delivery.

  • 10+ years of interior design and execution experience
  • 90+ completed projects across residential, commercial and hospitality
  • 90% on-time delivery record
  • 70+ quality checks on every project before handover
  • 290+ custom furniture designs for workstations, cabins and reception areas

You get a line-by-line BOQ before work starts, so the number you approve is the number you pay.

faqs.question: What is the average cost of office interior design in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: The average cost of office interior design in Gurgaon is ₹1,800 to ₹2,800 per sq ft for a mid-range turnkey fit-out in 2026. Basic offices start around ₹1,200 per sq ft, while premium and CXO-grade offices range from ₹2,800 to ₹7,000+ per sq ft.

faqs.question: How much does a 1,000 sq ft office interior cost in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: A 1,000 sq ft office interior in Gurgaon costs about ₹18 to ₹28 lakh at mid-range finishes and ₹28 to ₹45 lakh at premium finishes, excluding GST. It typically seats 12 to 18 people and takes 5 to 7 weeks to execute.

faqs.question: How much does office interior cost per seat in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Per-seat cost usually ranges from under ₹1 lakh for dense layouts at basic rates to ₹6 lakh or more for cabin-heavy, premium offices. Multiply your per-sq-ft rate by the total sq ft per employee, including shared areas, to get your own figure.

faqs.question: What is included in a turnkey office interior package?
faqs.answer: A turnkey office interior package covers space planning, 3D design, civil and partition work, false ceiling, electrical and lighting, HVAC distribution, flooring, furniture, project management and handover. Loose décor, IT hardware and GST are usually extra.

faqs.question: How long does an office fit-out take in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: An office fit-out in Gurgaon takes 8 to 16 weeks for most projects between 2,500 and 10,000 sq ft. That includes 3 to 5 weeks for design and approvals, followed by 6 to 12 weeks of site execution.

faqs.question: Is GST applicable on office interior design in India?
faqs.answer: Yes. Office interior fit-out work is generally taxed at 18% GST as a works contract. Businesses registered under GST can often claim input tax credit on part of it, so check with your accountant.
